text: {"lessons":["My account rose while I made no trades, but that short run does not prove that holding or recent gains predict future returns.","I should make buy and sell decisions based on risk, diversification, and current prospects—not avoid selling just to dodge admitting a mistake or rush to lock in a gain.","Before trading, I should check whether the decision fits my long-term plan; infrequent, deliberate review suits me better than reacting to random price moves."]}
